get.summary: Invitations addressed to me (the Notifications screen). Marks the returned page read.
Pending invitations I have not seen yet.

post.summary: Joins the project and returns it.

get.summary: Every live task and link of the project, with the version they are at.

parameters.name: dryRun
parameters.description: true: check the batch and show what it would do, without saving.

post.summary:
Applies a batch of changes, all or nothing. A rejected batch answers with
every problem in `errors`: 409 if any is about the current state (a
conflict, a cycle, a status rule), else 400.

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: The version the client is at: changes after it are returned.

410.description: The log no longer reaches back to `since`: reload the snapshot.

parameters.name: late
parameters.description: true: only late tasks, false: only tasks that are not late.

parameters.name: blocked
parameters.description: true: only blocked tasks, false: only tasks that are not blocked.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Planned date range: keeps tasks whose planned dates overlap [from, to].

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Case-insensitive match on the name or the task ID.

post.summary: Makes this task wait on another task of the same project.

info.title: SiteTrack API
info.description: Auth is cookie based: POST /auth/login sets httpOnly `access_token` and `refresh_token` cookies, POST /auth/refresh rotates them. Lists take `limit` (default 50, max 200) and `offset`.

isAdmin.description: Whether the caller is a project admin of this project.

total.description: Total matching rows across all pages.

adminSince.description: When they became project admin; earlier = more senior. Null for regular members.

status.description: Accept and Reject are only offered while pending.

answeredAt.description: When it was accepted, rejected or withdrawn.

readAt.description:
When the invitee first saw it, as it was before this request. Null means
new on this visit; listing marks the returned page as read.

total.description: Total matching rows across all pages.

count.description: Pending invitations the invitee has not seen yet.

version.description: Poll GET changes?since=<version> to stay up to date.

ref.description:
The client's name for the new task, unique within the batch. Other items
of the batch can use it in place of an ID; the response maps it to the
real ID. Must not start with "PRJ-".

status.description: Any move is allowed except back to not_started.

expect.description:
The values the client last saw. A field that has since been changed by
someone else to something other than `set` makes the batch fail with a
conflict; without `expect`, the last write wins.

version.description: The graph version the change produced; shared by every change of one batch.

data.description: create: every field. update: only the fields that changed, with their new values.

prev.description: update only: the values those fields had before.

by.description: User ID of who made the change.

refs.description: ref of every created task -> its ID.

version.description: The project's graph version after the batch (unchanged by a dry run or a batch that changed nothing).

changes.description: What the batch changed, as written to the changelog. Items that changed nothing are left out.

task.description: The task as the item named it.

hasMore.description: More changes are waiting: ask again right away with the new version.

dependsOn.description: IDs of tasks in the same project this task waits on.

steps.description: Fewest dependency steps between the two tasks; 1 means a direct link.

allowedActions.description: The status actions allowed right now.

waitsOn.description: Every task it waits on, directly or indirectly, nearest first.

waitedBy.description: Every task that waits on it, directly or indirectly, nearest first.

isLate.description:
Derived, never set by hand: not done and the planned end date has passed,
or not started and the planned start date has passed (server date).

isBlocked.description:
Derived, never set by hand: not done, and at least one task it waits on,
directly or indirectly, is not done.

dependsOn.description: IDs of the tasks it directly depends on, in ID order.

dependentsCount.description: How many tasks directly depend on it.

isLate.description:
Derived, never set by hand: not done and the planned end date has passed,
or not started and the planned start date has passed (server date).

isBlocked.description:
Derived, never set by hand: not done, and at least one task it waits on,
directly or indirectly, is not done.

dependsOn.description: IDs of the tasks it directly depends on, in ID order.

dependentsCount.description: How many tasks directly depend on it.

total.description: Total matching rows across all pages.
